items.prompt: A cinematic photorealistic still frame from a gentle contemporary campus romance, composed for a widescreen 16:9 film frame. In the foreground on the right, a 19-year-old university student in a cream cardigan stands beside a quiet tree-lined walkway, holding a closed notebook, looking toward a 20-year-old student in a pale blue shirt standing several steps away on the left. They exchange a subtle, hesitant smile without touching. The middle ground reveals sunlit grass, a few scattered fallen leaves, and a softly blurred university building; the background recedes into lush green trees. Late-afternoon natural sunlight filters through leaves, creating delicate highlights on hair and realistic skin, soft shadows, warm ivory tones and fresh muted greens. Eye-level medium-wide camera framing, natural 35mm lens perspective, clear visual separation between the two subjects, accurate hands, natural anatomy, believable fabric texture, subtle film grain and restrained cinematic color grading. A peaceful, wistful atmosphere, with balanced negative space in the center. No cyberpunk elements, neon lights, artificial-looking skin, exaggerated beauty filters, collage, or graphic overlays. The image contains no text, letters or numbers.
